title: Subagent Findings
description: Standardized findings output from a subagent dispatched via odeeppi/oflashpi. One file per task at untracked/T<id>-findings.json.

task_id.description: Task identifier — e.g. T169, T172, EXP-4. Must match the kanban task ID.

model.description: Model that executed the task — e.g. DSPro, DSFlash. Use the short form from subdelegation.md.

summary.description: One-line summary of what was found or built. Manager-facing; keep it under 120 characters.

claims_touched.description: List of CLAIMS.md claim IDs that this task touches (read, verified, falsified, or created). Empty array if none.

proposed_status.description: Proposed epistemic status for the touched claims, if any. 'none' when no claims are touched.

evidence_path.description: Path to the detailed evidence or notes file, relative to project root — e.g. untracked/T169-notes.md.

artifacts_produced.description: Paths to files produced by this task, relative to project root.

id.description: Short gap identifier — e.g. GAP-1, GAP-dump-format.

severity.description: CRITICAL blocks downstream tasks. HIGH is a likely correctness issue. Moderate needs resolution before ship. Minor is a documentation/clarity gap.

blocks.description: Comma-separated task IDs blocked by this gap, or null.

gaps_found.description: Gaps or issues discovered during the task. Empty array if none.

verification.description: Self-verification results — tests, calibrations, and cross-checks.

calibrations_passed.description: Names of calibration targets met — e.g. 'maxSCC=160 at 2x2'.

builds.description: Whether the produced code compiles successfully. null if the task produces no code.

next_steps.description: Recommended next actions for the manager — one sentence.

note.description: Extended notes. Use sparingly; prefer the evidence_path file for detail.
